fusions.name: Fouling Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 12 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flung Chips
fusions.desc: Flings 3 chips of reef at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Seeded Colony
fusions.desc: Seeds a colony of reef rats that fights for 20 seconds. Every second they bite an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage.

fusions.name: Last Off the Wreck
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12. You also regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.
